reviews.text: A very professional and caring veterinary clinic. A 10 out of 10!

An excellent clinic, especially thanks to María and Sami for their care; they were incredibly patient and attentive. My dog ​​is very nervous, and they treated him with so much love and care. The best!
Excellent service, thank you Samanta, great with Gatsby.
Tamara, Ana, and the reception staff are all very friendly. They are excellent professionals, have extensive experience, and above all, treat the dogs with immense patience and affection.

We went with our dog for the first time, Ana's treatment was excellent, he felt super comfortable and relaxed, he ended up giving her kisses, so even though he had two injections he felt at ease and so did we, she explained everything very well.
It would be wonderful if you could consider making the entrance accessible to people in the neighborhood who use wheelchairs. Thank you.

Fantastic Veterinary Clinic in the neighborhood! Attentive and very caring with pets! They also have a shop with pet food; they can locate the food you need for your pet and deliver it to the shop. Absolutely recommended! They're open all year round.

Our cat has been quite ill for the past few weeks. The clinic has provided excellent care in terms of medical procedures, tests, consultations, and so on, and the personal attention has been outstanding. They are always attentive to the animal and its progress, and during appointments they try to minimize his stress as much as possible.
They always treated my dog ​​Chispa wonderfully until her very last day. They are very kind, and if I ever have another pet in the future, I will definitely return. Thank you so much.
They are wonderful professionals and very kind. They took fantastic care of Chispa until her very last day. Thank you so much for the love and care you showed us.

An excellent and highly professional veterinary clinic. My dog ​​was suspected of having been poisoned by a ginkgo biloba fruit and received immediate attention. The team acted quickly and professionally, and explained everything very clearly.

It was also a great help to be able to communicate with the veterinarian in English, which gave us a lot of peace of mind during such a stressful time.

Thank you so much for the excellent care and treatment. I recommend this clinic without hesitation.
Honestly, the attention and assistance from the girls is wonderful; they always have the food that my April loves.

The whole team is AMAZING. The best. Special thanks to Ana, Tamara, and Samantha for all the times we've met ❤️‍🩹
We wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to everyone. They are super professional and attentive. They dedicate time, care, and patience to both their patients 🐶 and the humans who accompany them (who are sometimes the most challenging part).
Even though we've moved to the other side of Madrid, we know exactly who our vets are 💗

Thank you so much, ladies!
Pili⚘️

They're the best. Nobody takes care of my dog ​​Perico like this amazing team of vets. They treat him like he's their own; so much so that every time we pass by, he wants to come in and say hello. He feels right at home :).
The service, which is essential in this type of center, is unbeatable.

We stopped by the clinic and loved the service. The place is very welcoming and the staff were excellent. We bought some cans of food for Avril and were very happy with the experience. Definitely a place we would return to; they also recommend it, and it might be more to your kittens' liking.
Our pet received care from a very young but experienced veterinarian, and her professionalism is evident.

Very professional and attentive. I was recommended this clinic because my dog ​​has a heart condition and they specialize in it. Since then, they've been monitoring her and providing her treatment. I also take my cats there when needed. It's my go-to clinic, 100% recommended. 😊 …

I've been going to this veterinary clinic for about three years, and they've always treated me wonderfully and always taken care of my dog's needs.

10/10
Excellent service, the girls always take care of our dog Chia as if she were the queen of the house =)
The whole team always provides excellent service! They always greet you with a smile and are wonderful with my bunny! Special mention to Ana, our veterinarian, who is simply the best.

I went because my cat had swollen anal glands, and the doctor treated him wonderfully. She explained everything in detail, prescribed treatment, and drained my cat's glands, making him much better. Now we just hope the treatment continues to go well in the coming days!

We are so happy we chose this veterinary clinic for our pet Flora! The service is professional, they are incredibly caring with the animals, and dedicated to finding solutions for their needs. We highly recommend them! Thank you for your attention, Dr. Ana and Maria.
Our trusted vets ❤️ have always been quick, caring, patient, and dedicated whenever our dog has needed them, answering all our questions and giving us peace of mind 🐕. Highly recommended. …
The vets are amazing. They saved my dogs life Vida. Im forever grateful to them

The best, without a doubt.

We've been going to Donatella's for two years now, and I couldn't be happier. What I value most is their availability: on several occasions, I've arrived with emergencies, and they've always found me an appointment that same day without hesitation.

The treatment is incredible, both with the animals and the owners. They explain everything clearly, send reports, invoices, and even photos of them waking up from the anesthesia! They've been absolutely wonderful with my dog ​​during all the procedures (and there have been many: dental cleanings, surgeries, post-operative follow-ups, nail trimming, urinary tract infections, back problems…). They're so attentive, and they even write to me the next day to check on her.

It's clear that for them, my dog ​​is "one of the family," not just another patient, and that's priceless.

Thank you to the whole team, you're the best!!! ❤️🐾
I love this veterinary clinic. I always take my pets there, and the service is a 10 out of 10 from everyone who works there. I always recommend it as a trusted vet 🥰 …

We've been taking our dog there for 8 years and they've always been able to quickly diagnose what was wrong with him. They've also been very attentive and called to check on his progress. We're delighted with them! Thank you!

Excellent service. My cat, who is usually so skittish and fearful, felt comfortable and calm during the appointment (and even got to eat lots of treats!) and let them perform all the necessary tests without a fuss.

And when we got home, he went straight to take a peaceful nap.
I'm very happy with the clinic; the staff are professional and lovely. They explain everything very well, which gives me a lot of peace of mind.

My dogs are very timid, and they're always treated very well, with everything made as comfortable as possible for them. The vets are also very friendly and approachable. Thank you so much for everything!

I arrived terrified and crying with my almost 18-year-old dog suffering from urinary sepsis. Without an appointment, they treated her as an emergency, and the only negative thing I can say is that I regret not coming to this clinic sooner! A very thorough medical history, an exhaustive physical exam, and every test ordered was very sensible and well explained. Tamara has impeccable treatment for her patients; she arrived at the correct diagnosis and the correct and early treatment, and although at her advanced age the prognosis is still very guarded, my dog ​​has stopped crying and suffering and is starting to eat and drink... we'll see what happens, but the peace of mind of knowing she's in the hands of someone who knows what they're doing and who clearly does it with love is beyond words. I just want to express my deepest gratitude to everyone who treated us today, from the bottom of my heart. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic; with my moves, I've had several veterinarians, and this team is exceptional.

I haven't been going there my whole life, but in these past two years, this clinic has become indispensable to me.

When my older cats got sick, they were cared for with such love, patience, and dedication that I'll never forget. It's clear they love what they do.

During those difficult times, they weren't just there for them, but for us too. They kept us company, explained everything calmly, and made us feel like we weren't alone.

For me, it's not just a veterinary clinic; it's a place I trust, where you know they'll take care of your family as if they were their own. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything 🐾
They treated me wonderfully and were very kind, even with my 13-year-old dog. They are very professional.
Very happy with the service, the girls are lovely 🥰 …
Excellent attention and services, they always treat us with great care and attention to detail and our little one 🐶 always leaves happy ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️ …
Ana and Sam were amazing, my dog ​​Romeo was treated wonderfully and I will definitely stay here again. Thank you for the great service, it's a pleasure.

I want to leave this review with my deepest gratitude to everyone at La Almudena Veterinary Clinic, because the work they do there is impeccable, compassionate, and truly dedicated. It's clear they're a team that genuinely loves animals and also cares for the people who arrive worried, scared, or exhausted.

But if I have to single someone out, it's Ana.

Ana isn't just an excellent veterinarian: she's an extraordinary person. She literally went above and beyond for my cat Musgo. During one of his most difficult moments, she didn't hesitate to drive him to the hospital in her own car, going above and beyond what anyone would expect from her job. I'll never forget that gesture ❤️‍🩹

And now, with my cat Fidel, she's showing us what she's like once again. She's always treated him with boundless affection, patience, respect, and professionalism, and she's been there for us, explaining things, reassuring us, and supporting us during every visit. She treated Fidel and always did so with absolute dedication, as if he were her own.

Honestly, I've never met anyone as devoted to their work and to animals as Ana. Her involvement goes far beyond the professional: there's heart, there's commitment, and there's a genuine vocation that you feel from the very first moment.

Thank you, truly, to all the veterinarians at La Almudena for your daily work. And thank you, Ana, for being who you are. People like you make a difference and leave a lasting impact ❤️
Attentive and efficient.
The girls are lovely! I take both my dog ​​and cat, and all the services are 10/10. Always attentive, professional, and super affectionate with the little ones!

We went the other day in a bit of an emergency because of a stomach issue with our dog Gilda, after having been to another clinic several times where they barely gave her a few minutes of attention. Here they found a solution and, even though it was almost closing time, they treated us with patience and kindness. Thank you so much!

We moved to the neighborhood two years ago, and one of our biggest concerns was finding a trustworthy veterinarian for Nit, my 12-year-old black Labrador, who is already showing signs of aging. Luckily, we found the team at Clínica Veterinaria La Almudena.
Ana, Tamara, and the entire team have treated both my dog ​​and me wonderfully. I wouldn't say 10 out of 10, but 100 out of 100. Whether for routine visits or those frightening emergencies, like when she recently suffered an ear bite and I was distraught while Nit needed daily treatment, they have always looked after us, reassured us, and made us feel in the best hands. I sincerely believe they go far beyond the call of duty and what one would expect, always keeping a close eye on Nit's progress.
What reassures me most is seeing how they treat Nit: with love, professionalism, and patience. In fact, every time we pass by the clinic, she stops herself, wags her tail, and wants to go in. She feels truly cared for and loved, and she knows they're "doing good" for her. What better recommendation could there be than that of my own dog?

Thank you for taking such good care of our Nit. Esther

They always treat my chihuahua, Limón, with diligence and affection.
They are excellent veterinarians, and the rest of the staff is also very professional.

I recently moved to the area and my cat had to be hospitalized for several issues. This clinic referred him to the best hospital since it was a Saturday and my case was an emergency. They were in contact with the hospital, and everything went perfectly when he went for his check-up. They were incredibly attentive and involved. Communication was very easy and quick. They even put watermelon bandages on my cat, Silver.
Excellent professionals
If you're looking for a clinic near Puerta del Ángel, look no further. The vets are incredibly patient and caring with my dog, and very attentive. I couldn't have chosen a better clinic!
Ana and the rest of her colleagues are wonderful. They've been taking care of Bertín since he was little and are very patient with him if he gets nervous when there are injections and such.

Without a doubt, one of the best veterinarians we've ever had. We have dogs and cats, and they're always attentive to their vaccinations and needs. The care is exceptional, and the service they provide is outstanding. They treat pets with great affection and offer an emergency service! They recommend the best treatments whenever necessary! Thank you so much for your services and for being so professional; we appreciate your care.
Thank you to Ana Carrascosa for being so involved with my furry friend's problems :) She has always given me honest advice and treated him like her own pet!! 🙏🏼 …
Fantastic clinic with outstanding care from the staff, both for our pet and for us. Thank you!
Excellent service, both from the veterinarians and assistants, as well as the trainees (Andrea looked after us and my dog ​​left delighted). Very professional. Thank you all.
The whole team is amazing! My kittens couldn't be better cared for.

A review can't express our gratitude to this team of magnificent professionals. They are all lovely, but Ana is exceptional. A true professional through and through, she prioritizes the well-being of each patient above all else; her dedication and vocation are out of this world. I've encountered many veterinarians, but none like her. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. Thank you for everything you do for our furry friends (and there are many of them).
The way they treat both the owners and the animals is fantastic; everyone is super friendly.
Very grateful to all the staff, very professional and above all they treat my darling girl with so much love. 10 out of 10, highly recommended.

Discovering this clinic has been a miracle. We arrived with a very serious problem due to a botched operation. Michi had had a plate of the wrong size inserted in her paw, due to malpractice by the previous veterinarian. This had caused the skin on her paw to slough off, a bone infection, and months of despair for the animal. We thought amputation was the only option, as it looked awful, and the bone had shrunk after the X-ray. Ana and her team treated us incredibly well, with immense sensitivity and professionalism. The orthopedic surgeon who performed the operation was a work of art. I dare say that at another clinic, they wouldn't have even considered performing the operation that would have saved her paw. It was an extraordinary feat, which involved the removal and grafting of a bone from her hip. The operation was two months ago, and the kitten is perfectly fine; she doesn't even have a limp. It truly seems like magic. Many thanks to Ana and the rest of the team for their interest, dedication and treatment, and to the traumatologist who performed the operation, a magnificent professional who fixed what others could not have.

We were there with our little Max (a three-and-a-half-year-old dachshund), who gave us quite a scare, and we couldn't have asked for better care.

We came on behalf of Andrés, who has been a great help throughout the whole process. He's undoubtedly a true professional with a fantastic team.

From the moment we walked in, Maria, to Ana and Tamara who saw us in the consultation room, treated us like family, even though it was our first time visiting!

We came in with a situation that had us terrified, as Max had lost the ability to move his hind legs. We knew it was a possibility in this breed, but you never really expect it.

Luckily, and as they explained so well, in this case, his spine was simply compressed by bleeding, and he just needs rest and medication.

We hope everything goes well, but without a doubt, this kind of care, which even brings a smile to your face during difficult times, makes the process much more bearable and pleasant.
Excellent service! The team is amazing!

Excellent care and highly professional team.

After two years of trying different vets with no success, they finally diagnosed and managed a chronic urinary crystal issue in one of our cats. The difference in care and results was immediate.

We needed to travel internationally, they handled all the travel documents and vaccinations quickly and accurately.

Always responsive, helpful, and never make you feel judged for asking questions.

Both of our cats who normally don’t like strangers are comfortable and happy with the staff, even during vaccines.

Staff speak English should that be necessary.

Highly recommended.

It's in very bad taste to send a congratulatory WhatsApp message to my dog ​​Layka when she's been dead for four years. I don't even know them at all; I've never been to their clinic. I don't know where they got my phone number and my dog's name, but they're not truthful.

I'm so grateful to the whole team for taking such fantastic care of my two cats. They treat the cats with so much love and care to minimize stress. It's a great clinic, and a special thanks to Ana for her patience with me :)
Excellent service, with dedication and professionalism at all times. Highly recommended.

My dog ​​died during the recovery period from what they said was a simple operation. The surgery itself went well, but the two women who were monitoring her, with me present, didn't know how to react to the emergency. They had to call the vet on speakerphone. We're so sad. We made the mistake of going to this clinic; nothing will bring her back.

I want to thank you for the care you gave my dog, Trufa.
You are very professional.
The staff are very kind and attentive. A clean place 💜 …

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
An excellent experience

I am delighted with the treatment I received at La Almudena Veterinary Clinic. From the very first moment, the team was very professional, attentive, and caring with my dog. It's clear they love what they do and have a true vocation for animal care.

The service was quick, clear, and very compassionate. They explained everything in detail and answered all my questions with great patience. Furthermore, the clinic's atmosphere is welcoming, clean, and inspires a lot of confidence.

My dog ​​was treated with so much love and care, and as her owner, that gave me great peace of mind. I will definitely return and I recommend them 100%.

Thank you for everything, you're wonderful!

I'm very happy with the treatment my dog ​​receives from the entire team at the clinic. They always treat my dog ​​with so much love and patience and keep me informed every step of the way. My dog ​​loves going to the clinic. Thank you to veterinarians Ana and María for always being there, both on WhatsApp and in person.
Excellent professionals, kind and attentive!!! My dog ​​loves them. Kisses and thank you! 🌺🥰🥰🐶🐶 …
I love it, they always treat me and my pet wonderfully.
Amazing vet. Always bring my scooby here
We've been taking our little one there for three years now and we couldn't be happier. Thanks to Ana, Tamara, María, and the rest of the staff for being so professional.
Good service. I'm not giving it 5 stars so they can keep improving. Thank you.
We had an emergency and we weren't regular customers, but the doctor waited for us and treated us wonderfully.
The girls are super nice and very loving with animals, the best in the neighborhood by far
This morning I was with my dog ​​Yuna and I'm delighted. Ana's treatment of my dog ​​is wonderful; she's very professional and I love her as a person. I highly recommend the clinic.

We traveled from Granada with our dog Pongo for a complicated surgery (removal of a retropharyngeal tumor) because of the excellent recommendations we had for Andrés and the rest of the veterinary team. They organized the operation quite quickly. It was well worth it because everything went perfectly despite the risk. We are so grateful for everything they did for Pongo, as he is not an easy patient at all… We would definitely go back! We will always be incredibly grateful to them. The service was outstanding!
They're an amazing team. All the girls are wonderful and they inspired confidence in us from the very first minute. 100% recommended.

I can only speak highly of this clinic. I go to the cardiologist, and both he and the colleague who attends to us at reception and assists him are excellent professionals. They are incredibly loving with animals; it's clear they are dedicated to their work, judging by the care and patience with which they treated my dog. They explain things very well so that everyone understands perfectly. It's also clear they care deeply about the animals, and they are incredibly kind to us owners. My dog ​​Scooby has improved since last year, and that makes us very happy thanks to his diagnosis and appropriate treatment, which other places hadn't detected. Thank you both so much. For this reason, I give them five stars.
Diana
They explain everything well, good price
Excellent professionals. Very attentive at all times and they are helping us with our new puppy. 100% recommended.
Excellent service and incredibly professional. Of all the veterinary clinics I've been to with my pets, this is undoubtedly the best. Highly, highly recommended.

I think this is the second or third review I've written, although every review, star, and thank you is never enough. Once again, thank you to the entire team for their time, professionalism, quality of care, respect, affection, and the humane and "dog-like" way they treat our furry friends. Special thanks to Tamara and especially to Ana, who is always helpful and attentive. Oreo, although a dog, is back to his old self! :) Thank you!

I think this is the second or third review I've written, although every review, star, and thank you is never enough. Once again, thank you to the entire team for their time, professionalism, quality of care, respect, affection, and the humane and "dog-like" way they treat our furry friends. Special thanks to Tamara and especially to Ana, who is always helpful and attentive. Oreo, although a dog, is back to his old self! :) Thank you!

Very professional and highly recommended. Thanks to them, my dog ​​is alive; they detected a heart murmur very quickly.

Mavi Aldana
Highly professional and very gentle and caring with pets. Clear and detailed explanations of diagnoses, prompt attention, and state-of-the-art facilities and equipment. Excellent value for money.

We are very happy with the service and professionalism of the entire team; our cats are delighted with their patience and affection.
Thank you so much for everything.
I went to a vet appointment today with my dog ​​Revo, and Tamara and María answered all my questions and were incredibly kind and patient with both me and Revo. I highly recommend them! 💯🤗 …
Excellent service! Whenever the cat has a problem, they attend to her immediately 👍🏽 …

I've been taking my cat Nala to this clinic for a year now, and I'm so happy. They always treat her with so much love and patience and find the exact cause of whatever is wrong. I went to see Dr. Ana on a friend's recommendation, and I couldn't be happier. The whole team is wonderful, and I know my cat is in very good hands.

We chose this clinic because of its reviews, and we weren't wrong ✨ Everyone who works here is super (SUPER) nice, attentive, and dedicated. They treat you with professionalism and warmth, answering all your questions patiently and with time. Pili is thrilled, and now she's enjoying the Christmas gift this amazing team gave her. Thank you so much for everything, ladies 💓

From the very first moment, the treatment and welcome given to both the person and the animal were impeccable. I was very impressed by how patient and empathetic they were with our cat. They took excellent care of us at all times, explained everything in detail, and dedicated the necessary time to the consultation. I will continue to go to this clinic and I recommend it 100%!

Plus, they gave us two little gifts for the kitties 🙂

We took our kitten there and the service was amazing. The staff were incredibly respectful and cared for the animal from the moment it entered the clinic. They provided thorough explanations and were happy to answer any questions we had. Without a doubt, this is our go-to clinic 💚 …

They are spectacular with their care for pets; they are truly professional and explain everything in a very simple way so that everyone understands.
Whenever I've needed to visit them, I've left feeling completely at ease and with a great solution for Toy, my Yorkshire Terrier, who adores them.
And I must say, their service to pet owners is outstanding—they are incredibly attentive. Today was my last visit, and they even gave him a Christmas present! 100% recommended! Congratulations to the whole team!

My name is Iris, and ever since I brought my Chihuahua to Madrid, I've trusted this clinic from the moment I walked in the door! The staff are incredibly professional, every single one of them!
Thank you from the bottom of my heart, ladies, for taking such good care of Princesa. I know she's in the best hands!
Excellent professional and personal service, reasonable price, highly recommended clinic.
Whenever I go with my dog, they treat us wonderfully, very friendly and professional. Highly recommended.
I was there with my dog ​​and they treated her wonderfully, very professional.

I used to enjoy taking my pets to this place until one day they prescribed medication. When they administered it, he had an allergic reaction on one side of his face, affecting his eye. They denied it was an allergy, and instead injected him with an antihistamine when they saw how nervous I was. They told me to give him the medication again in two days, claiming it was impossible for the allergy to be caused by the medication. When they gave him the medication again, my dog ​​had the allergic reaction within minutes. They gave him another injection of antihistamines, but according to this clinic, it wasn't a medication allergy. They should know a little more, as it's painful for the animal to be given injections so frequently. They should study more, because even though I'm not a veterinarian, I could recognize an allergy, and you couldn't.

I took my dog ​​to the vet because he had bladder polyps. After a urine test, they told me it was cancer and that he only had four months to live without treatment. They recommended chemotherapy sessions, but said it was unlikely to work. I took my dog ​​to another vet, who told me that urine samples can't determine if a polyp is malignant and that it can only be verified through a biopsy. We had him operated on, they removed the polyp, and luckily it turned out to be benign. I'm so glad I got a second opinion and saved my dog's life. Otherwise, they would have been giving him chemotherapy, which would have been counterproductive for his health since he didn't actually have cancer and it wouldn't have solved the real problem. Seriously, be more careful with your diagnoses, and I recommend you go back to school for veterinary studies. This is the last time I'll take my dogs to that clinic. I wish there was an option to rate them with -1 star.

I don't know how to express my gratitude to this entire WONDERFUL TEAM 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🥹🫶🐾. Andrés, thank you so much! I highly recommend this clinic 💯. I assure you that your pets will be in the best hands. Ana is fantastic; she was persistent and examined my big boy, a Great Dane, from head to toe! She didn't miss a thing, constantly checking everything during tests, along with Tamara. Maria was very patient in the X-ray room, explaining how to hold the dog. Samanta was very attentive to the treatment process for both dogs, and I also have to say that they give excellent advice. You can tell it's their passion, not just a price. For me, the best in Madrid, without a doubt!
I'm even considering taking one of their reasonably priced courses because I like their approach. Excellent. Thank you all so much. 🙏🏻🐾🙏🏻🐾🙏🏻🐾💯

Thank you for explaining everything so clearly and directly, for addressing the most difficult issues so honestly and transparently, for always having my cat's best interests at heart, for seamlessly adapting to all the exceptional needs that arose, for making me feel so supported... and for being such wonderful people! Thank you so much. Jose Monedero

The staff are so kind and attentive! I regularly take my kitten there for various intestinal issues, all of which they've successfully resolved with treatment. They send you detailed reports and invoices so you can easily review your pet's medical history. I highly recommend this clinic!

What a great vet! We travel the world with our two cats, so we’ve visited many vets in different countries. This is one of the best. They handled our kitties so well, and patiently addressed all of our concerns. Having on-site blood …

I always love the way I'm treated, and Lucas and Pinny are great too.

I especially want to highlight Maria's kindness and her wonderful smile ♥️

We took our dog for the first time this morning and the experience was a 10/10. They saw us without an appointment, and even then, they weren't rushed to examine her. They were incredibly attentive and caring. 100% recommended.
I took Pepa, my cat, with me when she was in very serious condition, and thanks to their excellent work, patience, and care, they've pulled her through and she's improving. …

We are delighted with the treatment we received from the entire clinic team; they were incredibly professional and friendly with our pug.
Highly recommended.
Excellent service from the staff. I don't think there's a better vet than them. I recommend them 100%.
The girls are very kind and treat the animals with great affection.

I went to get my dogs vaccinated and the service was impeccable, especially with my most timid dog. The experience was very stress-free for her, which is a huge plus. Highly recommended, without a doubt.

I took my cat Oli there and they treated him very well. They are very professional and treated my cat with great care and affection at all times. The treatment they gave my cat worked and he recovered in just a few days. They followed up …
The team is phenomenal. Experts and incredibly kind, to the point that even though my beagle (senior) is very timid, they take me to visit them. And it's not for treats, he won't eat them! 😂 …
